text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"Clear opening claim and repeated stance throughout","quality":"thesis control","description":"The essay states its position plainly and keeps returning to it so the argument feels consistently directed."},{"evidence":"Three separate body paragraphs on safety, driver attention, and laws","quality":"organizational structure","description":"The essay develops its case in a more clearly segmented way, with distinct points that are easier to follow."},{"evidence":"Explains how semi-driverless cars still require an attentive person and why that is risky","quality":"reasoned elaboration","description":"The essay does more than mention evidence; it extends it into a logical argument about how the problem leads to danger."},{"evidence":"Discusses possible malfunction and uncertainty about responsibility","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay raises practical complications that strengthen its opposition by anticipating what could go wrong."},{"evidence":"Uses connective phrases like 'Therefore,' 'Which means,' and 'In conclusion'","quality":"cohesive transitions","description":"The writing uses more explicit transitions to guide the reader through the progression of ideas."}]}
